Set final bounds with epsilon adjustment to prevent division by zero [S1, unofficial]:

The evidence explicitly states that the code sets `lo` and `hi` using automatic bounds with an epsilon adjustment (`lo = lo or (lo_auto - eps); hi = hi or (hi_auto + eps)`). This adjustment is performed to ensure the denominator `np.abs(hi - lo)` in the subsequent normalization step `(value - np.minimum(lo, hi)) / np.abs(hi - lo)` is non-zero, thereby preventing division by zero.
